name: L08 · Daily stale Jira stories report

parameters.content:
## 🧭 L08 · Jira for Scrum teams
Finds In-Progress stories with no update for N days and emails the list.
Edit the JQL in *Search Stale Stories* (project key!) and the days in **⚙️ Config**.

options.jql: =project = {{ $json.project_key }} AND statusCategory = "In Progress" AND updated <= -{{ $json.stale_days }}d ORDER BY updated ASC
